disclaimer: These are synthetic DEMO weights for plumbing and education only — not PGS Catalog scores, not height/BMI estimates, and not medical risk. Replace with an open PGS Catalog file under data/reference/prs/catalog.json for real exploratory scores.
how_to_read: Each score is a weighted sum of effect alleles on a tiny SNP list. Higher raw score only means more of those weighted alleles on your chip — it is not a centimeter, kg/m², or disease probability. Coverage (variants used) matters: a score from 1 SNP is almost meaningless.

scores.what_it_is: A toy sum of a few height-associated SNPs. Real height PRS use hundreds to thousands of markers and still do not predict your height precisely.
scores.what_it_is_not: Not your height in cm/inches. Not a growth diagnosis.
scores.citation: Synthetic GenoLens demo — not from PGS Catalog

scores.what_it_is: A toy sum centered on well-known FTO-region SNPs used in BMI research. Real BMI PRS are much larger panels.
scores.what_it_is_not: Not your BMI, weight, or a diet plan. Not obesity diagnosis.
scores.citation: Synthetic GenoLens demo — not from PGS Catalog

scores.what_it_is: A tiny weighted sum using CYP1A2-related markers. Overlaps the idea of the single-SNP caffeine card in Wellness/Pharma — here shown as a multi-SNP toy score.
scores.what_it_is_not: Not a coffee prescription or safe-intake limit.
